content: Modern Web Stack: Frontend Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. Backend Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI). Database PostgreSQL + Prisma/Drizzle ORM. Auth Clerk, NextAuth, Supabase Auth. Rule: Always use Server Components by default. Use Client Components only when interactivity is needed. Always use Zod for input validation.
